articles.title: Dark Smoke Billows After Horrific Collision Between Flying Cars
articles.summary: Two flying cars collided with each other during an airshow rehearsal in Changchun, a city in northeastern China. Videos on social media show emergency response vehicles at the scene as a big plume of dark smoke billows from one of the wrecks. Fortunately, neither of the electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) vehicles, developed by the Xpeng Aeroht subsidiary of EV giant Xpeng, had anybody on board. "All personnel at the scene are safe, and local authorities have completed on-site emergency measures in an orderly manner," the company said in a statement to CNN.
